data.name: Theoniel
data.gender_notes: Theoniel is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek 'Theos' (God) and 'Nielos' (gift). In Christianity, it can be associated with the biblical figure of Theonius, a Christian martyr in Rome, or with the Greek goddess Theia, whose name is also a variant of Thea (Goddess), evoking the idea of a divine gift. The name Theoniel carries the meaning “God's gift” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Theoniel usually hope their child will grow to embody god's gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the gift of God's love and grace.
data.etymology: Theoniel belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's gift.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Theoniel total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_hebrew.name: תיאוניאל
in_hebrew.meaning: אל הוא האל שלי, שמי הוא אלוהים
in_hebrew.long_meaning: תיאוניאל הוא שם עברי שמורכב משתי מילים: 'תיאו' שפירושו אל או אלוהים ו'ניאל' שפירושו שמי או אלוהים שלי. לכן, תיאוניאל יכול להתפרש כ'אל הוא האל שלי' או 'שמי הוא אלוהים'. השם תיאוניאל מופיע בתנ"ך כחלק מהמסורת היהודית והוא נושא משמעות רבה בהקשר הדתי והרוחני.

in_greek.name: Θεονιέλ
in_greek.meaning: Ο Θεός είναι ο Θεός μου
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Θεονιέλ είναι σύνθεση δύο λέξεων: 'Θεό' που σημαίνει Θεός και 'νιέλ' που σημαίνει ο Θεός μου ή το Θεό μου. Η ερμηνεία του ονόματος Θεονιέλ είναι 'Ο Θεός είναι ο Θεός μου' ή 'Ο Θεός είναι ο δικός μου Θεός'. Στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας, το όνομα Θεονιέλ φέρει μεγάλη πνευματική σημασία και συνδέεται με την πίστη και την αφοσίωση στον Θεό.

in_latin.name: Theoniel
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Theoniel ex duabus partibus constat: 'Theo' quod significat Deum et 'niel' quod significat Deus meus vel Deus est meus. Interpretatio nominis Theoniel est 'Deus est Deus meus' vel 'Deus est proprius meus Deus'. In traditione christiana, nomen Theoniel magnam spiritualem significationem habet et cum fide et devotioni ad Deum coniungitur.

in_english.name: Theoniel
in_english.meaning: God is my God, divine will
in_english.long_meaning: The name Theoniel is derived from Hebrew roots, combining 'theo' (God) and 'niel' (my God or divine will). The meaning of Theoniel is 'God is my God' or 'divine will'. Theoniel carries significant spiritual connotations in Christian tradition, symbolizing devotion, faith, and divine providence. Historically, the name reflects a deep connection to biblical heritage and early Christian practices.

data.cultural_impact: The name Theoniel carries a rich cultural significance due to its Greek roots, reflecting the historical and philosophical influence of ancient Greek civilization on the development of the Christian faith. It can evoke images of Roman martyrs and early Christian scholarship, inspiring a connection to the past and a sense of deep tradition.
data.spiritual_significance: On a more personal level, Theoniel can be seen as a reminder of the divine gift of faith and grace, emphasizing the spiritual importance of recognizing and receiving God's love and blessings. This name can thus serve as a daily reminder and encouragement to live a life devoted to God and to share His gifts with others.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Theoniel may be derived from the Greek words "theos" (God) and "aniel" (God's messenger or grace). It symbolizes a strong connection to God and the divine, as well as a role in spreading God's love and grace to others.

historical_references.reference: The Venerable Theoniel, or the History of the Holy Martyr Theoniel, is a late medieval hagiography written in Catalan language around the 15th century. It describes Theoniel as a martyr from Asia Minor who was tortured and killed by the Romans during the Diocletian persecution (early 4th century). The text includes various miracles attributed to Theoniel.

The Legend of Theoniel, a 17th-century French work, tells the story of a priest named Theoniel who was martyred during the Valerian persecution (250-253 AD). The text describes how Theoniel refused to surrender sacred vessels to Roman soldiers, leading to his arrest, torture, and eventual death. This hagiography also includes various miracles attributed to Theoniel.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Theoniel, of Hebrew origin meaning 'God is gracious', has seen a modern resurgence in various contexts. In the realm of contemporary literature, it is popular among indie authors as an unusual and evocative name for their characters. Roleplaying games, such as Dungeons & Dragons, have seen players choosing this name for their elven or divine characters due to its unique and mythic sound. Social media platforms, particularly Instagram, have seen an increase in users adopting Theoniel as a unique and aesthetically pleasing username, often accompanied by profile pictures featuring ethereal landscapes, mythical creatures, or spiritual symbols.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted Christian named James Theoniel in Jerusalem, Israel credits much of their spiritual journey to their name Theoniel, which means "God's gift". They believe their name has been a blessing and reminder of God's presence in their life.
